# Privacy

This is a personal website. It has no accounts, comments, or ads, sets no cookies, and I don't sell or share data with anyone.

## Visit counts

The site counts visits with [Cloudflare Web Analytics](https://www.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/). It sets no cookies, stores nothing in your browser, and does not follow you across sites. It records the page you open, the site that linked you here, and your browser, device type, and country. Cloudflare receives your IP address to serve the script and processes this data under its [privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

## Other services

Fonts are served from this site itself. A few other requests also send your IP address to the service:

- The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may log visitor IP addresses for security ([GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)).
- Pages with equations load MathJax from the jsDelivr CDN, and a small compatibility script from Cloudflare's cdnjs.
- Course notebooks show an "Open in Colab" badge loaded from Google Colab.
- The slide decks under `/slides/` load their fonts from Google Fonts.
